title: Test a generator for variety
statement: Test a generator for variety by sending it the same request several times and measuring how far the outputs differ; one whose outputs barely differ is static.
example: The benchmark sends each request 10 times, scores the outputs' diversity by trigram Jaccard distance, and calls the generator static below 0.45.
detail: The AP work's evaluator has a variety check that takes the caller's own requests, sends each one 10 times, and scores the responses' diversity by trigram Jaccard distance (`icloud-work/inceptbench-main/README.md`). A mean score below the default threshold of 0.45 marks the generator as static (`icloud-work/inceptbench-main/src/inceptbench/tools/variety_check.py`).
against: The 10 sends and the 0.45 threshold are the tool's own defaults; no validation of either was found.

evidence.quote: - Sends each provided request 10 times, scores response diversity via trigram Jaccard distance
is_static = (variety_score < self.threshold) if variety_score is not None else None
